cases.sentence: Я ваш брат Иосиф, которого вы продали в ___.
cases.translation: I am your brother Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into a place takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: He made me a father to Pharaoh.
cases.explain: The predicate noun after сделать (to make someone something) stands in the instrumental case.

cases.translation: He made me a father to Pharaoh.
cases.explain: 'A father to Pharaoh' expresses the person related, which takes the dative case.

cases.translation: You will live in the region of Goshen.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Иосиф дал им ___, как приказал фараон.
cases.translation: Joseph gave them wagons, as Pharaoh had commanded.
cases.explain: The transitive verb дать takes its direct object (the wagons) in the accusative case.

cases.translation: To each he gave new clothing.
cases.explain: The transitive verb подарить takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.translation: But to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver.
cases.explain: The material measured (shekels of silver) takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Отцу он послал десять ослов, нагруженных лучшим ___ Египта.
cases.translation: To his father he sent ten donkeys loaded with the best goods of Egypt.
cases.explain: The material something is loaded with (нагруженный) stands in the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Иосиф сказал братьям, «Я Иосиф, жив ли еще мой отец?»
reading.question: What did Joseph first ask his brothers when he revealed himself?
options: Whether his father was still alive
reading.correct: Whether his father was still alive
reading.explain: Joseph asks 'жив ли еще мой отец?' (is my father still alive?).

reading.ru: Это Бог послал меня перед вами для спасения вашей жизни
reading.question: Why does Joseph say he was sent to Egypt?
reading.explain: Joseph says God sent him ahead 'для спасения вашей жизни' (to save your life).

reading.ru: Он обнял своего брата Вениамина и заплакал, и Вениамин плакал, обнимая его.
reading.question: How did Joseph react to seeing Benjamin?
reading.explain: The text says Joseph embraced Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept too.

reading.ru: Иосиф дал им колесницы, как приказал фараон, и припасы в дорогу.
reading.question: What did Joseph give his brothers for the journey?
reading.explain: The text says Joseph gave them wagons and 'припасы в дорогу' (provisions for the road).

reading.ru: У Иакова замерло сердце, и он не поверил им.
reading.question: How did Jacob first react to the news that Joseph was alive?
options: His heart went numb and he did not believe them
reading.correct: His heart went numb and he did not believe them
reading.explain: The text says Jacob's heart froze and he did not believe them.

reading.ru: И Израиль сказал, «Довольно, мой сын Иосиф жив, пойду и увижу его, прежде чем умру».
reading.question: What did Israel decide to do?
options: To go and see Joseph before he dies
To send more sons to Egypt
To wait for Joseph to come to him
reading.correct: To go and see Joseph before he dies
reading.explain: Israel says he will go and see Joseph 'прежде чем умру' (before I die).
